en: Orangutans are great apes with long arms and shaggy orange-brown hair. In the wild, they live only in the rainforests of Borneo and Sumatra.
Their name comes from the Malay and Indonesian words 'orang' and 'hutan'. It means 'person of the forest'.
Orangutans spend most of their lives up in the trees. They swing from branch to branch using their strong arms.
They eat mostly fruit, such as wild figs. They also eat leaves, bark, flowers and insects.
Every evening an orangutan builds a new bed high in a tree. It bends branches into a nest and lines it with leaves. On rainy nights, it may hold a big leaf over its head like an umbrella.
A baby orangutan stays close to its mother for many years. She teaches it which foods to eat and how to build a nest.
Orangutans are in danger because many forests have been cut down. Protecting forests protects their homes.
id: Orangutan adalah kera besar berlengan panjang dengan rambut lebat berwarna cokelat kemerahan. Di alam liar, mereka hanya hidup di hutan hujan Kalimantan dan Sumatra.
Namanya berasal dari kata 'orang' dan 'hutan'. Artinya 'orang yang tinggal di hutan'.
Orangutan menghabiskan sebagian besar hidupnya di atas pohon. Mereka berayun dari dahan ke dahan dengan lengan yang kuat.
Makanan utamanya buah, misalnya buah ara hutan. Mereka juga makan daun, kulit kayu, bunga, dan serangga.

Setiap sore, orangutan membuat tempat tidur baru tinggi di pohon. Ia menekuk dahan menjadi sarang dan melapisinya dengan daun. Saat malam hujan, ia kadang memegang daun besar di atas kepala seperti payung.
Bayi orangutan tinggal dekat induknya selama bertahun-tahun. Induknya mengajarinya makanan apa yang boleh dimakan dan cara membuat sarang.
Orangutan terancam punah karena banyak hutan sudah ditebang. Menjaga hutan berarti melindungi rumah mereka.

factChecks.claim: Wild orangutans live only on Borneo and Sumatra.
The name orangutan comes from Malay/Indonesian words meaning 'person of the forest'.
Orangutans eat mostly fruit and build a new sleeping nest in the trees each night.
Young orangutans stay with their mothers for many years.
Orangutans are endangered mainly because of forest loss.
